name: Marieke Ehlers - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the application of the Treaty provisions related to the principles of subsidiarity and proportionality and the role of national parliaments in the EU legislative process
part_text:
The European Parliament says the EU should only make laws when countries cannot achieve the goal themselves, and should not go further than needed. It asks the European Commission to justify each proposal more clearly, to consult national parliaments earlier, and to give them more time and easier rules for raising objections. It also asks for better checks on emergency law-making and suggests a future "subsidiarity court". This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to justify proposals better and consult national parliaments earlier.
- **Who it affects:** The European Commission, national and regional parliaments, and local authorities implementing EU rules.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission and national parliaments; any real change needs Treaty revision or the Commission's agreement.
